emberCrown.name: Ember Crown
emberCrown.text: A crown of banked fire, for heroes who walked out of Ember Hollow.

starWeaver.name: Star-weaver's Hat
starWeaver.text: A tall hat stitched with the old sky.

foxHood.name: Fox Hood
foxHood.text: Ears up. Felkin swear it is not a joke about them.

emberBrand.name: Emberbrand
emberBrand.text: A blade with a coal for a heart. Hits exactly as hard as the sword you wear under it.

moonwardStaff.name: Moonward Staff
moonwardStaff.text: A crescent on a pale staff, for the healers who keep the night watch.

spiritLantern.name: Spirit Lantern
spiritLantern.text: It lights nothing but the way home.

royalCoat.name: Royal Coat
royalCoat.text: Two coats, wine and teal, with gold down the front.

supporter.name: Supporter
supporter.text: A star by your name in chat and the Patron's Circlet to keep. Pays for the servers. On iOS and Android it renews monthly until you cancel in your store account; on Steam it is 30 days at a time and never renews.

seasonTrack.name: Season track
seasonTrack.text: Every premium look on this season's track: twenty of them, earned by playing. The ones you already reached arrive at once.
